Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:

news:1crqe0tuf114lmua2...@4ax.com...


Anthelios was distributed with Gehenna pre-release materials
(some princes however did not get their pre-release Anthelios)
It was also distributed in Scrye Magazine.
It is also apparently going out in regular tournament support kits,
hopefully available from your prince.

Dan and Gilbert were only available at tournaments at the time
(at least that is my understanding), so Anthelios already has
a more spread out distribution. I would suspect that more Anthelios
have been produced than Dan and Gilbert but that is pure speculation.

-JTP

> 1) All novels are technically non-canon (only 2 'n's there, BTW)

Are you referring only to WoD novels or WoX novels in general? I only ask
because with things like Star Wars and B5, where the property is
essentially owned by a single person, information is so tightly controlled
that all novels are canon *unless otherwise stated*, whereas with Star
Trek and some other pulp series, the product is only maybe 50/50.
